description: This file defines an Express.js route handler for listing products in a marketplace. It exports a method 'list' that processes query parameters and calls a service function to retrieve filtered products, returning the result as JSON.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of products, applying filters and sorting based on query parameters.

ctags.name: products
ctags.pattern: /^    const products = getProducts({ age, priceMin, priceMax, brand, sortBy, sortOrder });$/
